items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: This is a group that was formed by Oliver Jackson, Bill Pimperton and myself after we left Earl in July of 1969.

ctx.x: You know, Bill and myself were working together with a -- with a partnership now, called the JPJ Quar-
tet, which means the Jackson, Pemberton, and Johnson, and we've of course been together since 1969.
